title: Gate-validates-wrong-artifact detector (Tier 1 #5)
intent: Flag a validation gate that inspects something other than the artifact the function ships: green gate, wrong artifact shipped. Two shapes: a value validated and then modified before it is returned (the gate ran before the artifact was final), and a locally built value validated and then abandoned while a different local build is returned (the gate checked the wrong object).

scope.out_of_scope_notes: Ship sites are return statements only; write/export sinks and derivation tracing (is the shipped value derived from the validated one?) are left to a v2 pass, flagged by Finding.metadata gate_covers_shipped_confirmed=False. Under-detection is the deliberate trade: the abandoned signal requires the validated name to be a local build (not a parameter) that is entirely unused after the check, so validate(input); return transform(input) is not flagged.

what_changed: Added src/code_audit/analyzers/gate_wrong_artifact.py (GateWrongArtifactAnalyzer 1.0.0) with two rules: GATE_WRONG_ARTIFACT_MODIFIED_001 (validated, then reassigned or mutated, then returned) and GATE_WRONG_ARTIFACT_ABANDONED_001 (validated local build unused after the check while a different local build is returned). Per-function AST facts, no descent into nested scopes. finding_id is the make_fingerprint value, never empty.
Added AnalyzerType.GATE_WRONG_ARTIFACT and registered the analyzer in api._DEFAULT_ANALYZERS (the registry contract test requires the exact set).

Refreshed confidence_policy, confidence_golden and logic manifests on Python 3.11. The enum value sits in the confidence closure, so the two confidence hashes move; this is a benign closure change, signal_logic_version stays signals_v5.

Merged current main (3a4717e) into the branch, which was cut from 3802ccf. api.py and model/__init__.py conflicted additively (main added four analyzers since); resolved as a union, main's entries first.

Cleared three debt-ratchet items in the new analyzer without touching the baseline: removed a dead snippet computation and the src_lines parameter that only fed it (long_parameter_list on _emit_abandoned), made _finding take a Location (long_parameter_list), and split _visit into _visit_assign/_record_mutations with a flat if-dispatch instead of an elif chain, which nests in the AST (deep_nesting). Behavior-preserving: the 12 analyzer tests pass unchanged and old/new produce identical findings over the repo's 337 .py files.
diff_articulation.why_not_redundant: No existing analyzer relates a validation call to the value that leaves the function. The shape is the scale-validation defect class from the roadmap: every check passes while the shipped artifact was never checked, so no test or gate observes it.
